# Fixed-first-fit weighted NLS reference control

These files are generated by `examples/mma05p2nls/weighted_reference.R` using
base R 4.6.1. The three synthetic rows are x=(-1,0,1), y=(2.2,1.6,2.2).
No author data are redistributed here. Reproduce into a new directory and compare
the four CSV files and `versions.txt`; R version differences can alter last digits.

The initial and weighted solutions have mean 2, a=-log(2), b=0. Both weighted
fits have classical covariance diag(.02,.03), HC1 covariance diag(.02,.015),
and level RSS .24; transformed RSS is .12 for WNLS and .06 for FGNLS. The
reference generator separately verifies these closed-form quantities, rank,
curvature, score, full Gauss-Newton step, and weight-normalization invariance.
The values are a reference, not evidence that the native workflow exists.
